F_isWrapWordsInResponsible.answer: NO — ruled out for the mcq nodes
F_isWrapWordsInResponsible.evidence: wrapWordsIn does fire in this chapter (718 className assignments; the first five all trace to wrapWordsIn via chapter-app.js:3008), but every mcq-region event traces to colorWordsIn instead. The two are distinct functions with distinct guards.
F_isWrapWordsInResponsible.correctionToP33: P33 named wrapWordsIn the strongest candidate and stated it has no LINK_EXCLUDE guard. Both points are now corrected: (a) wrapWordsIn DOES guard — its TreeWalker rejects text whose parentElement.closest(LINK_EXCLUDE) matches (chapter-app.js:2843-2844); (b) it is not the mcq producer.

G_whichOfTheFourCallPaths.:3008: sentence-inline-unit wrapWordsIn — fires (it produced the first 5 captured events) but never touches mcq content
G_whichOfTheFourCallPaths.actual: a fifth, previously unexamined path: mcqBlock:3050 → colorWordsIn:2928

H_whyLinkExcludeIsBypassed.rootCause: colorWordsIn HAS NO EXCLUSION TEST AT ALL. Its TreeWalker acceptNode (chapter-app.js:2930-2932) filters only on "does this text contain a letter" — unlike wrapWordsIn (:2843-2844) and gatedWrapWordsIn (:2916), neither of which would have touched this text.
H_whyLinkExcludeIsBypassed.secondaryFactor: even if colorWordsIn had wrapWordsIn’s guard, it is called at :3050 while the button is DETACHED but its .de is already inside button.mcq-option, so closest(LINK_EXCLUDE) WOULD still match — the guard would work. The bypass is purely the missing check, not a timing/attachment problem.
H_whyLinkExcludeIsBypassed.intentNote: colorWordsIn appears purpose-built to COLOUR words in a region that is deliberately not interactive — it creates spans with a role class but binds NO click handler (contrast wrapWordsIn:2866, which does). The clickability that produces the QA findings therefore does not come from colorWordsIn’s own handler.
H_whyLinkExcludeIsBypassed.openQuestion: if colorWordsIn attaches no click listener, what makes these spans behave as clickable words for the QA engine? qa-engine.js selects .rw/.de-link by CLASS, so they are counted and popup-probed purely because they carry .de-link. Whether a learner can actually open a popup on them was NOT re-verified in this phase.

I_oneMechanismForAll14: STRONGLY SUPPORTED, not fully proven. All 14 sit in mcq/reading-question options, and the b2-15 subset is proven to come from mcqBlock:3050 → colorWordsIn. The other chapters were not individually stack-captured.

J_affectsNonMcqContent.otherCallSites: chapter-app.js:3050 (exercise mcq) and :3350 (reading-question mcq) were seen in this trace; a full call-site census of colorWordsIn was not performed in this phase
J_affectsNonMcqContent.implication: any region coloured via colorWordsIn receives .de-link spans with no LINK_EXCLUDE consideration
